SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram

Class ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram.ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer
public final class ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer extends Object
Source-connected professional P&ID scenes, ISO-basis content checks and deterministic pagination.

This renderer consumes the same physical projection as the native DEXPI materializer. Material, sensing and control connections are distinct. Named signal continuations avoid confusing crossed wires with physical junctions. Missing controlled design information is retained as HOLD; it is never supplied from operating values. Drawing-content checks do not constitute independent ISO qualification, safety approval or fitness for construction.

1.0

    • renderProcessFlowOverview

      public NativeEngineeringDiagramRenderer.Result renderProcessFlowOverview()
      Renders a source-only A1 PFD overview for a small, forward-flow train.

      Up to four primary units are supported. Actual valves, streams and normal operating data are retained; proposed instrumentation is excluded. Branched or reverse-flow arrangements are checked using the same geometry diagnostics as the P&ID, rather than being declared complete merely because a PDF exists.

      Returns:
      native PFD SVG/PDF and geometry diagnostics
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if this instance was already used
      IllegalArgumentException - if the source exceeds the supported overview size

    • placeSharedFunctions

      private void placeSharedFunctions(ProfessionalPidDiagramRenderer.Scene scene, Set<String> placed)
      Draws all locally represented inputs to one voting function without overlapping continuation symbols.

      Each input ends at a distinct point on the existing safety-function envelope. A function spanning sheets keeps explicit signal continuations instead; no missing source is silently implied by the local fan-in.

      Parameters:
      scene - current source-backed sheet
      placed - already represented proposals
